idea-plugin.name: MASMLD GNU Linker Script
idea-plugin.description:
Independent GNU ld linker-script support for IntelliJ Platform IDEs.

  • Dedicated .ld file type and file icons.
  • Syntax highlighting and tolerant structural parsing.
  • Offline Chinese quick documentation for 48 linker commands and built-in functions.

Requires MASMLD Core; no CPU architecture module or RISC-V selection is required. Enable quick documentation on hover in editor settings. The plugin does not run the linker, expand templates or resolve linker-script symbols.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.7.0: First public release under the MIT license. Adds blue/purple modular cube branding and navigation from same-file macro calls and .purgem to .macro definitions. Includes assembly and linker-script highlighting, offline documentation, file icons and host source-symbol navigation.
